lines.text: Earth's core hides enough gold to coat the planet.
And that's not even the strangest part.
When the young Earth was molten, heavy iron sank to the center, dragging gold with it.
Scientists estimate there's enough gold down there to cover the whole surface,
about half a meter deep. Knee-deep, everywhere.
lines.caption: about 0.5 m deep. Knee-deep, everywhere.

lines.text: The strange part? More than ninety-nine percent of Earth's gold is down there.
lines.caption: The strange part? More than 99% of Earth's gold is down there.

lines.text: Every gold ring ever made comes from the tiny bit left up here.
Sounds fake? It's true. Follow for more.
